description: Create the complete project structure, configuration system, data models, and CSV logging module. This establishes the foundation: pyproject.toml with all dependencies, config loading from YAML + env vars, Pydantic models for job data, and a real-time CSV logger.
steps: Create pyproject.toml with dependencies: playwright, pyyaml, pydantic, python-dotenv, click, and dev deps: pytest, pytest-asyncio

Create src/naukri_apply/models.py with Pydantic models: UserProfile (name, email, phone, resume_path, linkedin_url, experience_years, current_company, current_designation, notice_period), JobListing (company_name, job_title, location, url, apply_type enum: EASY_APPLY/EXTERNAL/UNKNOWN), ApplicationResult (job listing + status enum: APPLIED/FAILED/SKIPPED/EXTERNAL_PARTIAL + timestamp + notes)

Create src/naukri_apply/config.py that loads configuration from a YAML file (path passed via CLI or env var NAUKRI_CONFIG_PATH). The YAML file contains: user_profile fields, naukri credentials (email/password), output_csv path, browser settings (headless bool, slow_mo ms, user_data_dir for session persistence). Support .env file loading via python-dotenv for secrets overlay.

Create src/naukri_apply/logger.py with CSVLogger class: initializes CSV file with headers if not exists, appends a row for each ApplicationResult in real-time (flush after each write). Headers: timestamp, company_name, job_title, location, url, apply_type, status, notes.
Create .env.example with placeholder variables: NAUKRI_EMAIL, NAUKRI_PASSWORD, NAUKRI_CONFIG_PATH
Create config.example.yaml with all configuration fields documented with comments
Create tests/conftest.py with shared fixtures (tmp_path based config file, sample UserProfile, sample JobListing)
Create tests/test_config.py testing config loading from YAML file
Create tests/test_logger.py testing CSV writing and append behavior
Create a virtual environment, install the package in dev mode, and run pytest to verify all tests pass
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml is valid and pip install -e '.[dev]' succeeds
Config loads correctly from YAML with env var overrides for secrets
Models validate input correctly (e.g., invalid email raises validation error)
CSVLogger creates file with headers and appends rows correctly
All tests in tests/ pass with pytest
verification: Run: pyenv local 3.11.15 && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'
